description: Upload a video (mp4/webm/mov, up to 200MB) into the publisher-bound AR project's asset library via video_url. Returns asset_id for linking to a calendar row (linked_asset_id).

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

publisher_pid.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project.

upload_caption.description: Optional asset caption stored on the AR asset row.

video_url.description: Public https URL to download the video from (mp4/webm/mov, up to 200MB).

name: upload_publisher_video
